definition_en: a building for watching plays, the writing and performance of plays as an art, or a place where major events unfold
core_image: 大幕拉开：一屋子人在黑暗里同看台上一方被灯照亮的小世界
scene: 剧院侧门人流涌出，她攥着刚买到的票。The theatre was packed before the curtain went up.
sceneCN: 这里 theatre 是「剧院」（第 1 个义项：观演戏剧的建筑）；句意：大幕未启，剧院已座无虚席。

pos.zh: 剧院；戏院；戏剧（艺术）；战场；手术室（英式旧用）

derivatives.zh: 戏剧的；夸张做作的（theatre 加形容词后缀 -ical 构成）
戏剧性地；做作地（theatrical 加副词后缀）
戏剧演出；业余演戏（复数名词）
圆形露天剧场（amphi- 表「两侧」加 theatre，指环形观看）

senses.title: A building for watching plays
senses.definition: a building or outdoor area where plays and performances are given to an audience
senses.definitionCN: 供观众观看戏剧与演出的建筑或露天场所
senses.example: The oldest theatre in the city dates from the eighteen twenties.
senses.exampleCN: 城里最古老的剧院建于十九世纪二十年代。
senses.why: The word first names the place where watching happens: rows of seats facing a lit stage.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先指「观看发生之地」：一排排座椅面向亮灯的舞台。

senses.title: The art of writing and acting plays
senses.definition: the art or profession of writing and performing plays
senses.definitionCN: 创作与表演戏剧的艺术或行业
senses.example: She has worked in the theatre for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 她从事戏剧工作已有二十年。
senses.why: The place lends its name to the activity that fills it, then to the whole art.
senses.whyCN: 场地的名字转给充满它的活动，再转给整门艺术。

senses.title: A scene of important events
senses.definition: a place where important events happen, used figuratively, as in the theatre of war
senses.definitionCN: 重大事件发生之地，比喻用法，如战区
senses.example: Eastern Europe became the main theatre of the conflict.
senses.exampleCN: 东欧成为这场冲突的主要战区。
senses.why: History borrows the stage: wherever the great scene is played becomes a theatre.
senses.whyCN: 历史借走舞台：大戏在哪里上演，哪里就是 theatre。

senses.title: An operating room
senses.definition: a room in a hospital where operations are performed, in British usage
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中指医院施行手术的房间
senses.example: The patient was moved into theatre within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 病人几分钟内就被推进了手术室。
senses.why: The surgeon works under lights before watchers, like a stage performance turned inward.
senses.whyCN: 外科医生在灯下、在注视中工作，像一场向内翻转的舞台演出。

intro.en: Theatre comes from Greek theatron, a place for seeing, from theasthai, to behold. The Greeks built the word before they built the stone seats.
intro.cn: theatre 出自希腊语 theatron「观看之所」，词根 theasthai 意为观看。希腊人先造出这个词，才造出石砌的座位。

items.en: Theasthai meant to look at, to gaze upon, and theatron named the seeing place of the hillside audience.
items.cn: theasthai 意为注视、凝望；theatron 命名山坡上观众的「看台」。

items.en: The root also gave theory, a beholding of truth rather than of plays; watching is the shared image.
items.cn: 同一词根还给出 theory「理论」——凝视真理而非戏剧；「观看」是共同意象。

items.en: Latin borrowed theatron as theatrum, keeping both the building and the figurative stage of affairs.
items.cn: 拉丁语把 theatron 借作 theatrum，兼指建筑与比喻性的事件舞台。

items.en: French theatre carried the word into medieval English texts about ancient spectacles.
items.cn: 法语 theatre 把这个词带进中世纪英语谈古代奇观的文章。

items.en: English took theatre in the fourteenth century; the playhouse sense grew with real playhouses.
items.cn: 英语于十四世纪借入 theatre；剧场义随真实剧场的出现而生长。

items.en: Modern English added the art sense, the theatre of war, and the British operating theatre.
items.cn: 现代英语添加了艺术义、战区义与英式手术室义。

note.en: The first group follows the seeing root into neighbouring words; the second separates the watching places.
note.cn: 第一组沿「观看」词根走进邻近词；第二组区分各种观看场所。

entries.definition: a beholding of truth; the same Greek seeing root pointed at ideas instead of plays
entries.definitionCN: 理论；同一希腊「观看」词根指向了观念而非戏剧

entries.definition: of the theatre; also exaggerated and showy in manner
entries.definitionCN: 戏剧的；亦指举止夸张做作

entries.definition: the study of God; shares the th- look but the root is different
entries.definitionCN: 神学；字形相近但词根不同

entries.definition: a building for films rather than live performance
entries.definitionCN: 电影院；放映电影而非现场演出

entries.definition: the platform itself, or the acting profession; narrower than theatre
entries.definitionCN: 舞台本身或演艺行业；比 theatre 窄

entries.definition: the listening hall; names the audience space inside any venue
entries.definitionCN: 礼堂；指场馆内的观众空间

normalIntro.en: Real links: the Greek seeing root, theory from the same root, the operating theatre, and the theatre of war.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：希腊「观看」词根、同根的 theory、手术室、以及战区。

normal.en: Theatron means a place for seeing; the seats exist for the gaze.
normal.cn: theatron 意为观看之所；座位为目光而设。

normal.en: Theory and theatre share one root: watching truth and watching plays.
normal.cn: theory 与 theatre 同根：凝视真理与观看戏剧。

normal.en: An operating theatre turns the stage lights onto the patient.
normal.cn: operating theatre 把舞台灯转向病人。

normal.en: The theatre of war is where history plays its largest scenes.
normal.cn: theatre of war 是历史演出最大场面的地方。

normal.en: Theatrical praise sounds like acting: too many gestures.
normal.cn: theatrical 的赞美听起来像演戏：手势太多。

abstract.en: Every theatre is an agreement to watch together in the dark.
abstract.cn: 每座剧场都是一场「在黑暗中共同观看」的约定。

abstract.en: History needs a stage before it needs a script.
abstract.cn: 历史需要舞台，然后才需要剧本。

abstract.en: Seeing is the oldest art: the Greeks built a word for it first.
abstract.cn: 观看是最古老的艺术：希腊人先给它造了词。

examples.en: We booked two seats at the National Theatre.
examples.cn: 我们在国家剧院订了两个座位。

examples.en: Theatre in this city survived the fire and the plague.
examples.cn: 这座城市的戏剧挺过了大火与瘟疫。

examples.en: The Pacific became the central theatre of the naval war.
examples.cn: 太平洋成为海战的主战区。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西厄特」——想坐「好席位」特不容易，得早起去剧场 → theatre 剧院

root: 希腊语 theasthai「观看」→ theatron「观看之所」→ 拉丁语 theatrum → 古法语 theatre → 英语；同根词 theory。

sensesIntro.en: From the Greek seeing-place, theatre grows into the playhouse, the art performed inside it, the figurative stage of war, and the surgeon's lit room.
sensesIntro.cn: 从希腊的观看之所出发，theatre 长成剧场、场内的戏剧艺术、比喻性的战区舞台，以及外科医生灯下的房间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit stage ringed by watching eyes in the dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑暗中被众多目光环绕的亮灯舞台。

branches.en: The building exists for the gaze.
branches.cn: 建筑为目光而存在。

branches.en: The place names the art that fills it.
branches.cn: 场地把名字借给充满它的艺术。

branches.en: Big events borrow the stage for themselves.
branches.cn: 大事件把舞台据为己用。

branches.en: The surgeon works watched under lights.
branches.cn: 外科医生在灯下被注视着工作。

branches.en: Building and art share one seeing root.
branches.cn: 建筑与艺术共享同一观看词根。

intro.en: Theatre builds with the adjective suffix -ical, the adverb -ly, and the prefix amphi- for the all-round viewing ring.
intro.cn: theatre 用形容词后缀 -ical、副词 -ly，以及表「环视」的前缀 amphi- 构词。

latinIntro.en: Latin theatrum is the direct channel from Greek; the seeing root also reached English through theory and its family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 theatrum 是希腊词的直接通道；观看词根还经 theory 一族抵达英语。

items.example: His theatrical sighs fooled no one.
items.exampleCN: 他夸张的叹气谁也骗不了。

items.meaning: in a dramatic or exaggerated way

senses.title: Belonging to a mentioned group
senses.definition: relating to or belonging to the people or things already mentioned as they
senses.definitionCN: 属于前文以 they 提及的人或物的
senses.example: The children forgot their umbrellas on the train.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们把伞忘在了火车上。
senses.why: Possession follows the pointing word they: the group is named, the things belong to it.
senses.whyCN: 所有跟随指向词 they：群体已被点名，东西便归属它。

senses.title: For a single person of unknown gender
senses.definition: used with a singular meaning for a person whose gender is unknown or unstated
senses.definitionCN: 用于性别未知或未说明的单个人，作单数意义
senses.example: Someone left their phone in the meeting room.
senses.exampleCN: 有人把手机落在了会议室。
senses.why: When the sex is hidden, English reaches for the plural form as the fairest neutral hand.
senses.whyCN: 当性别隐藏时，英语伸手取复数形式作最公平的中立之手。

senses.title: Belonging to things or animals
senses.definition: relating to animals or things treated in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 指代复数形式的动物或事物

senses.exampleCN: 雨后蚂蚁重建了蚁巢。
senses.why: The same possessive serves things and animals once they are named with they.

intro.en: Their is Old Norse in origin: Old English had its own possessive hierarchy, but the Scandinavian settlers' pronoun þeirra pushed into English and won the slot.
intro.cn: their 源自古诺斯语：古英语本有自身的所有格体系，但斯堪的纳维亚移民的代词 þeirra 挤进英语并占据了位置。

items.en: The Norse possessive þeirra meant of them, from their third person plural pronoun.
items.cn: 诺斯语所有格 þeirra 意为「他们的」，出自其第三人称复数代词。

items.en: Native English hiera was the old possessive of they, but it was weak against the Norse form.
items.cn: 本族的 hiera 原是 they 的所有格，但在诺斯形式面前渐弱。

items.en: Settlers in the Danelaw used þeir, þeim, þeirra daily, and the contact zone adopted them first.
items.cn: 丹麦法区移民日常使用 þeir、þeim、þeirra，接触地带率先采纳。

items.en: Middle English spelled the word their, ther and her, the Norse form steadily displacing the native one.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 their、ther、her，诺斯形式逐步取代本族词。

items.en: Modern English fixed their, added the singular neutral use, and separated the independent theirs.
items.cn: 现代英语固定 their，加入单数中立用法，并分立出独立的 theirs。

note.en: The first group is the they-family around the possessive; the second contrasts the two possessive shapes.
note.cn: 第一组是围绕所有格的 they 词族；第二组对比两种所有格形态。

entries.definition: the independent possessive: this phone is theirs, not their phone alone
entries.definitionCN: 名词性物主代词：可独立使用

entries.definition: the place word; sounds identical to their in most accents
entries.definitionCN: 地点词；多数口音中与 their 同音

entries.definition: the contraction of they are; sounds the same again, written differently
entries.definitionCN: they are 的缩写；发音相同写法不同

entries.definition: the possessive of it; their is its plural partner
entries.definitionCN: it 的所有格；their 是其复数搭档

entries.definition: the older gendered pair now often replaced by singular their

entries.definition: follows their to stress possession, as in their own house
entries.definitionCN: 跟在 their 后强调所有权

normalIntro.en: Real links: the Old Norse þeirra, the trio their, there, they're, and the singular neutral use.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：古诺斯语 þeirra、their/there/they're 三胞胎、以及性别中立单数用法。

normal.en: Their came from the Vikings: Norse þeirra beat native hiera.
normal.cn: their 来自北欧海盗：诺斯语 þeirra 击败了本族 hiera。

normal.en: Their, there, they're sound alike but hold different jobs.
normal.cn: their、there、they're 同音不同工。

normal.en: Someone left their phone: one person, plural word, no bias.
normal.cn: someone left their phone：一个人，复数词，无性别偏向。

normal.en: The ants and their nest: things take their too.
normal.cn: 蚂蚁与 their nest：事物也用 their。

normal.en: Their own house stresses whose it is.
normal.cn: their own house 强调归属。

abstract.en: A possessive is the grammar of ownership's grey zone.
abstract.cn: 所有格是所有权灰色地带的语法。

abstract.en: When we cannot see, we borrow the plural to stay fair.
abstract.cn: 看不清时，我们借复数来保持公平。

abstract.en: One Viking word quietly rewired English possession.
abstract.cn: 一个北欧词悄悄重接了英语的所有权系统。

examples.en: The players wore their new strips for the first time.
examples.cn: 球员们首次穿上了他们的新队服。

examples.en: Every candidate must bring their own calculator.
examples.cn: 每位考生必须自带计算器。

examples.en: The bees protect their hive fiercely.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂拼命守护蜂巢。

sensesIntro.en: Their starts as the Norse possessive of they, serves animals and things, and finally covers the single unknown person where English once reached for his or her.
sensesIntro.cn: their 起于 they 的诺斯所有格，服务动物与事物，最终覆盖英语曾以 his or her 处理的未知性别单数。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: umbrellas lined on a shared rack, all belonging to the group named.
core.cn: 核心意象：共用的伞架上排开的伞，都属于被点名的那群人。

branches.en: Possession follows the group already pointed at.
branches.cn: 所有跟随已被指向的群体。

branches.en: The plural hand reaches for the hidden single person.
branches.cn: 复数之手伸向被隐藏的单数个人。

branches.en: Things and animals take the same possessive.
branches.cn: 事物与动物使用同一所有格。

branches.en: People and things share one borrowed word.
branches.cn: 人与物共享一个借来的词。

branches.en: Fairest when the sex is simply unknown.
branches.cn: 性别未知时它最公平。

items.meaning: the subject form of the group pronoun

definition_en: the independent possessive form of they, standing alone instead of before a noun

scene: 外套都挂在门后，她拎起一件。The red jacket on the hook is theirs, the kids left it this morning.
sceneCN: 这里 theirs 是「他们的（东西）」（第 1 个义项：独立使用的名词性物主代词）；句意：钩子上的红夹克是他们的，孩子们早上落下的。

pos.zh: 他们的（东西）；名词性物主代词

senses.title: Stand alone for what belongs to them
senses.definition: stands in place of a noun phrase, meaning the thing or things belonging to them
senses.definitionCN: 替代名词短语，指属于他们的东西
senses.example: The blue car by the gate is theirs.
senses.exampleCN: 门口那辆蓝车是他们的。

senses.whyCN: 形容词性所有格要靠名词支撑；独立型什么也不靠。

senses.title: In the partitive pattern a ... of theirs
senses.definition: used after of to count one among several things they own, as in a friend of theirs
senses.definitionCN: 用于 of 之后，指他们拥有的多个之中的一个，如 a friend of theirs
senses.example: A cousin of theirs came to the wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的一位表亲来参加了婚礼。
senses.why: Ownership shrinks to one item picked out of the whole they hold.
senses.whyCN: 所有权缩小到从他们全部所有中挑出的一件。

senses.title: Contrast two sides' possessions
senses.definition: used to contrast what one group owns with what another owns
senses.definitionCN: 用于对比一群体与另一群体的所有
senses.example: Their costs are lower than ours.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的成本比我们的低。
senses.why: The pronoun turns ownership into a contest between two camps.
senses.whyCN: 代词把所有权变成两个阵营之间的对垒。

intro.en: Theirs is the Norse possessive þeirra plus the English -s ending that marks independent possessives, in line with hers, ours and yours.
intro.cn: theirs 是诺斯所有格 þeirra 加上英语标记独立所有格的 -s 词尾，与 hers、ours、yours 平行。

items.en: Norse þeirra supplied the base meaning of them.
items.cn: 诺斯语 þeirra 提供了「他们的」这一词基。

items.en: Native English had parallel independent forms like ure, ours, and eower, yours.
items.cn: 本族英语已有平行的独立形式，如 ure（ours）与 eower（yours）。

items.en: The Norse pronoun family þeir, þeim, þeirra entered English through daily contact in the north.
items.cn: 诺斯代词家族 þeir、þeim、þeirra 经北方日常接触进入英语。

items.en: Middle English attached the -s of hers and ours, forming theirs as a new independent form.
items.cn: 中古英语套上 hers 与 ours 的 -s，造出独立形式 theirs。

items.en: Modern English standardised theirs, keeping it distinct from their used before nouns.
items.cn: 现代英语规范 theirs，使其区别于接名词的 their。

note.en: The first group is the pronoun family around the independent possessive; the second lines up the parallel independent forms.
note.cn: 第一组是独立所有格周围的代词家族；第二组排列平行的独立形式。

entries.definition: the possessive that must lean on a noun; theirs stands alone

entries.definition: the place word; one letter from theirs and identical in sound
entries.definitionCN: 地点词；与 theirs 只差一字母且同音

entries.definition: the independent possessive of the feminine singular
entries.definitionCN: 阴性单数的独立所有格

normalIntro.en: Real links: the -s of ours and hers, the a friend of theirs pattern, and the theirs versus ours contrast.

normal.en: Hers, ours, yours, theirs: one family of free-standing possessives.
normal.cn: hers、ours、yours、theirs：能独立站立的所有格家族。

normal.en: A friend of theirs picks one from the group's whole set.

normal.en: Their car needs a noun; theirs does not.

normal.en: Theirs is not ours: two camps, two claims.
normal.cn: theirs 不是 ours：两个阵营，两种主张。

abstract.en: Ownership needs a shape that can stand when the noun has gone home.
abstract.cn: 所有权需要一种在名词下班后仍能站立的形态。

abstract.en: Possession is clearest when it is contested.
abstract.cn: 所有权在被争夺时最清晰。

abstract.en: One suffix turns an adjective into a survivor.
abstract.cn: 一个词缀把形容词变成能独立存活者。

examples.en: Ours is the quiet house; theirs is the loud one.
examples.cn: 安静的房子是我们的；吵闹的是他们的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the unlabelled coat on the hook that everyone knows is theirs.

branches.en: Possession becomes a comparison of camps.

branches.en: Standing alone and facing ours are two states of the same form.
branches.cn: 独立与对望是同一形态的两种状态。

senses.title: Receive the action

senses.title: After prepositions

senses.title: For a single person of unknown gender

items.en: Þeim was the dative case of the Norse plural pronoun, the case of receiving.
items.cn: þeim 是诺斯复数代词的与格，表承受之义。

items.en: Native English used hem for the object of they, a form still heard in Middle English.
items.cn: 本族英语用 hem 作 they 的宾格，中古英语仍能听到。

items.en: Contact in the Danelaw carried þeim into the daily speech of mixed communities.
items.cn: 丹麦法区的接触把 þeim 带进混合社区的日常语言。

items.en: Middle English shows both hem and them for centuries; them slowly won.
items.cn: 中古英语数世纪并用 hem 与 them；them 渐胜。

normal.en: Tell them I called: one caller, neutral pronoun.
normal.cn: tell them I called：一位来电者，中性代词。

normal.en: After to, for, of and with, them takes the object slot.
normal.cn: to、for、of、with 之后，them 占据宾语位。

abstract.en: Grammar has a giving side and a receiving side; every sentence must choose.
abstract.cn: 语法有施与受两端；每个句子都要选边。

abstract.en: Vikings furnished the whole plural crew: they, them, their.
abstract.cn: 北欧人配齐了整个复数班子：they、them、their。

abstract.en: A pronoun that refuses to guess is a pronoun that respects.
abstract.cn: 拒绝猜测的代词是一种尊重。

examples.en: The committee invited them to present the findings.
examples.cn: 委员会邀请他们汇报研究结果。

examples.en: Among them were two doctors and a pilot.
examples.cn: 他们中有两位医生和一名飞行员。

examples.en: Someone parked behind them and blocked the exit.
examples.cn: 有人停在他们的车后，堵住了出口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「载姆」——东西都「载」到他们那「亩」地上了 → them 他们（宾格）

root: 古诺斯语与格 þeim「他们（宾格）」→ 取代古英语本族 hem → 中古英语并行渐胜 → 现代英语唯一宾格；与 they、their、themselves 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Them lands the verb's action on the group, fills the slot after prepositions, and finally serves the single person whose gender the sentence refuses to guess.
sensesIntro.cn: them 让动词之力落在群体上，填满介词后的空位，最终服务于句子拒绝猜测其性别的单个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the ball crossing to the crowd, the landing pad of every action.
core.cn: 核心意象：球飞向人群——所有动作的落点。

branches.en: The verb's force arrives on the group.
branches.cn: 动词之力抵达群体。

branches.en: Prepositions park the group behind them.
branches.cn: 介词把群体停在自己身后。

branches.en: One unknown caller is still safe in them.
branches.cn: 未知的来电者在 them 中安然无恙。

branches.en: Verb objects and preposition objects share one pad.
branches.cn: 动词宾语与介词宾语共用一块垫子。

branches.en: The neutral use keeps grammar kind.
branches.cn: 中性用法让语法保持善意。

intro.en: Them has no affixes; it is one case form inside the pronoun family of they.
intro.cn: them 没有词缀；它是 they 代词家族中的一个格位形式。

latinIntro.en: Them is Norse; the Latin accusative plural is given only as contrast.
latinIntro.cn: them 属诺斯语源；拉丁宾格复数仅作对照。

items.example: They knew the answer.
They chose their seats.
The fault is theirs.
They blamed themselves.
Let them be; they need rest.
items.exampleCN: 随他们去，他们需要休息。

items.example: Between them they raised the money.
All of them voted yes.
We saw him at the bank.

definition_zh: 主题；题目；主旋律；（乐）主调；（店铺、派对等的）主题风格
definition_en: the main subject of a talk, book, or event; a recurring melody; or a style built around one idea
core_image: 一条主线从一堆素材里被抽出来：所有细节都挂在它上面
scene: 班会的横幅已经挂起来，孩子们在排练。The theme of this year's science week is water.
sceneCN: 这里 theme 是「主题」（第 1 个义项：谈话或活动的中心题目）；句意：今年科学周的主题是水。

pos.zh: 主题；题目；主旋律；（语法）主题位

derivatives.zh: 主题的；主题相关的（theme 加形容词后缀构成）
按主题地；主题上（thematic 加副词后缀）
把……设为主题（学术用语）
主题公园（复合词）

senses.title: The main subject of a work or talk
senses.definition: the subject or idea that a talk, book, film or event keeps returning to
senses.definitionCN: 谈话、书籍、电影或活动反复回归的题目或思想
senses.example: Loneliness is the theme of her latest novel.
senses.exampleCN: 孤独是她新小说的主题。
senses.why: Out of many details one line is pulled straight: everything else hangs on it.
senses.whyCN: 从繁杂细节中抽直一条线：其余一切都挂在上面。

senses.title: A recurring melody in music
senses.definition: a short melody that returns and is developed throughout a piece of music
senses.definitionCN: 在乐曲中反复出现并被展开的短旋律
senses.example: The opening theme returns before the final movement.
senses.exampleCN: 开头的主题在末乐章前再次出现。
senses.why: A melody can do what an idea does: leave and come back, each time wearing new clothes.
senses.whyCN: 旋律能做思想做的事：离开又归来，每次都换上新衣。

senses.title: A style built around one idea
senses.definition: a style or setting arranged around a single idea, as in a themed party or park
senses.definitionCN: 围绕单一观念布置的风格或场景，如主题派对、主题公园
senses.example: The café opens with a railway theme.
senses.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆以铁路为主题开业。
senses.why: One idea becomes wallpaper, chairs and music: the theme leaves the page and furnishes the room.
senses.whyCN: 一个观念变成墙纸、座椅与音乐：主题离开纸面，开始布置房间。

senses.title: The starting point of a sentence in grammar
senses.definition: in linguistics, the point of departure of a sentence, what the sentence is about
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中句子的出发点，即句子所关涉者
senses.example: In this sentence, the weather stands as the theme.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个句子里，天气处于主题位。
senses.why: Grammar borrows the idea: a sentence also picks a line to hang its news on.
senses.whyCN: 语法借用此概念：句子也要挑一条线来挂自己的新信息。

intro.en: Theme goes back to Greek thema, a thing laid down or proposed, from tithenai, to place. The subject is literally the thing set down in front of the audience.
intro.cn: theme 可追溯到希腊语 thema「被放置、提出之物」，出自 tithenai「放置」。主题字面义就是摆在观众面前的那件东西。

items.en: Tithenai meant to place or set, and thema named what has been set down: a proposal, a subject.
items.cn: tithenai 意为放置；thema 指被放下之物：提案、题目。

items.en: The same placing root gave thesaurus, a treasure-house of laid-up words, and thesis, a thing set forth.
items.cn: 同一「放置」词根还给出 thesaurus「收藏语词的宝库」与 thesis「被摆出的论点」。

items.en: Latin borrowed thema and used it in rhetoric and music theory for the underlying subject.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 thema，用于修辞学与音乐理论中的底层题目。

items.en: English took theme through Latin texts, at first for the subject of a logical proposition.
items.cn: 英语经拉丁文本借得 theme，最初指逻辑命题的题目。

items.en: Modern English extended it to music, then to parties and parks styled around one idea.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到音乐，再扩展到围绕单一观念布置的派对与公园。

note.en: The first group walks the placing root into related words; the second separates theme from its near neighbours.
note.cn: 第一组沿「放置」词根走进相关词；第二组把 theme 与近邻分开。

entries.definition: a thing set forth; an argument placed before readers, from the same Greek placing root
entries.definitionCN: 论题；从同一希腊「放置」词根而来

entries.definition: the object pronoun; looks one letter from theme, unrelated in origin
entries.definitionCN: 宾格代词；字形只差一字母，词源无关

entries.definition: the adjective of theme, describing what belongs to the theme
entries.definitionCN: theme 的形容词，描述属于主题者

entries.definition: what is talked about; smaller and more concrete than theme
entries.definitionCN: 话题；比 theme 更小更具体

entries.definition: the area treated; subject names the field, theme names the idea inside it
entries.definitionCN: 题材；subject 指领域，theme 指其中思想

entries.definition: a recurring small pattern; a motif is a thread, a theme is the rope
entries.definitionCN: 反复出现的小图案；motif 是线，theme 是绳

normalIntro.en: Real links: the Greek placing root, the thesis of the same root, the theme song, and the themed café.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：希腊「放置」词根、同根的 thesis、主题曲、以及主题咖啡馆。

normal.en: Thema is a thing laid down: the subject placed before you.
normal.cn: thema 是被放下之物：摆在你面前的题目。

normal.en: Thesis and theme both come from placing something before readers.
normal.cn: thesis 与 theme 都来自「摆在读者面前」。

normal.en: A theme song returns like the idea it carries.
normal.cn: 主题曲像它承载的观念一样反复出现。

normal.en: Theme park: an idea big enough to furnish a whole park.
normal.cn: theme park：一个大到足以布置整座园子的观念。

normal.en: Motif is the thread; theme is the rope made of threads.
normal.cn: motif 是线；theme 是由线拧成的绳。

abstract.en: To have a theme is to choose what the rest must serve.
abstract.cn: 有了主题，就是选定其余一切必须服务的对象。

abstract.en: The strongest themes return quietly rather than loudly.
abstract.cn: 最有力的主题静默回归，而非喧哗。

abstract.en: An idea can decorate a room as easily as a paragraph.
abstract.cn: 观念布置房间与布置段落一样容易。

examples.en: The theme of the conference is cities and climate.
examples.cn: 本次大会的主题是城市与气候。

examples.en: The film's main theme returns at the closing scene.
examples.cn: 影片的主旋律在结尾场景再度响起。

examples.en: They decorated the hall on a harvest theme.
examples.cn: 他们以丰收为主题布置了大厅。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西姆」——辩论赛抽到「西」「姆」两队对决，主题就定它了 → theme 主题

root: 希腊语 tithenai「放置」→ thema「被提出之物」→ 拉丁语 thema → 英语；同根词 thesis、thesaurus。

sensesIntro.en: From a thing set down before the audience, theme grows into the subject of works, the returning melody, the styled café or park, and even the grammarian's starting point.
sensesIntro.cn: 从摆在观众面前的物件出发，theme 长成作品题目、回归的旋律、有风格的咖啡馆与公园，乃至语法学家的出发点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one line pulled straight out of a heap of material, everything hanging on it.
core.cn: 核心意象：从一堆材料中抽直的一条线，万物挂其上。

branches.en: The placed thing becomes the subject.
branches.cn: 被放下之物成为题目。

branches.en: A melody repeats the placing: it returns and returns.
branches.cn: 旋律重复这一放置：反复回归。

branches.en: The idea leaves the page to furnish real rooms.
branches.cn: 观念离开纸面去布置真实房间。

branches.en: Grammar keeps the line for sentence openings.
branches.cn: 语法为句首保留这条线。

branches.en: Subject and melody share the shape of return.
branches.cn: 题目与旋律共享「回归」的形状。

intro.en: Theme builds the adjective thematic, the adverb thematically, and compounds with park and song.
intro.cn: theme 构成形容词 thematic、副词 thematically，并与 park、song 复合。

latinIntro.en: Latin thema is the channel from Greek; the placing root also produced thesis and thesaurus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 thema 是希腊词的通道；放置词根还造出 thesis 与 thesaurus。

items.example: The chapters follow a thematic order.
The book is thematically organised.

items.meaning: a statement set forth for argument
items.example: Her thesis defended a bold claim.
items.exampleCN: 她的论文为一个大胆论点辩护。

items.example: Use a thesaurus for richer wording.

items.meaning: a park built around one idea
items.example: The theme park opened in June.

items.meaning: the song linked to a show
items.example: The theme song topped the charts.
The study thematizes urban loneliness.
items.exampleCN: 该研究把都市孤独设为主题。

items.meaning: a map showing one chosen theme
items.example: A thematic map traced the rainfall.

definition_zh: 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己（they 的反身代词；亦作性别中立单数）
definition_en: the reflexive form of they, used when the group both does and receives the action, also for emphasis, and for a single unknown person
core_image: 照镜子：做动作的人和被动作碰到的人是同一群
scene: 布景塌了，剧组的人手忙脚乱。The cast built the stage props themselves, no professionals were hired.
sceneCN: 这里 themselves 是「他们自己」（第 1 个义项：反身代词，动作施受同一）；句意：剧组亲手制作了舞台道具，没请专业人员。

pos.zh: 他们自己；亲自；亦作单数性别中立用法

derivatives.zh: 我自己（第一人称反身代词，同构词法：宾格 + selves）
你们自己（第二人称复数反身代词）
我们自己（第一人称复数反身代词）
他们（themselves 的宾格基础）

senses.title: Reflexive: doer and receiver are the group
senses.definition: used when the group performs the action and the action falls back on the same group
senses.definitionCN: 群体发出动作而动作又落回同一群体
senses.example: They taught themselves French from videos.
senses.exampleCN: 他们靠视频自学法语。
senses.why: Mirror grammar: the sentence turns the group around to face itself.
senses.whyCN: 镜像语法：句子把群体转回身面对自己。

senses.title: Emphatic: done without help
senses.titleCN: 亲自； themselves 用于强调
senses.definition: used after a noun or pronoun to stress that the group did it without help
senses.definitionCN: 用于名词或代词之后，强调群体亲力亲为
senses.example: The workers themselves painted the mural.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们亲自画了这幅壁画。
senses.why: The same shape is carried into a second position just to add weight.
senses.whyCN: 同一形态被挪到第二个位置，只为增加分量。

senses.title: For a single person of unknown gender
senses.titleCN: 某人自己（性别中立单数）
senses.definition: used with singular meaning for a person of unknown gender, though themself is also accepted
senses.definitionCN: 用于性别未知的单个人，themself 亦被接受
senses.example: Anyone who injures themselves at work must report it.
senses.exampleCN: 任何在工作中伤到自己的人都必须上报。
senses.why: The plural reflexive borrows itself out to the hidden single person.
senses.whyCN: 复数反身代词把自己外借给被隐藏的单数个人。

intro.en: Themselves is a double old compound: the Norse dative them plus self with the plural ending -s. English built its whole reflexive family this way, selves made from self.
intro.cn: themselves 是双重古老复合：诺斯与格 them 加 self 再加复数词尾 -s。英语整个反身代词家族都如此构成，selves 由 self 变来。

items.en: Self was already a stressing word; old reflexives often used the plain object form instead.
items.cn: self 早已是强调词；古反身用法常用普通宾格形式替代。

items.en: The Norse dative them supplied the object half of the compound.
items.cn: 诺斯与格 them 提供了复合词的宾格半边。

items.en: Middle English produced himself, herself, ourselves, yourselves on the model of me, myself.
items.cn: 中古英语按 me, myself 的模式造出 himself、herself、ourselves、yourselves。

items.en: The compound themselves spread by analogy, replacing the shorter native forms.
items.cn: 复合式 themselves 类推扩散，取代了更短的本族形式。

items.en: Modern English fixed themselves for the plural and for the neutral singular, with themself emerging beside it.
items.cn: 现代英语固定 themselves 用于复数与中性单数，themself 在其旁萌生。

note.en: The first group is the reflexive family built the same way; the second sorts the nearby self words.
note.cn: 第一组是同法构造的反身代词家族；第二组排列相邻的 self 类词。

entries.definition: our group's reflexive, built from us plus selves
entries.definitionCN: 我们的反身代词，由 us 加 selves 构成

entries.definition: your group's reflexive, same construction
entries.definitionCN: 你们的反身代词，构造相同

entries.definition: the emerging singular reflexive for one unknown person
entries.definitionCN: 针对未知单数的萌生反身形式

entries.definition: one does to the other and the other to one; reflexive is one self-directed action
entries.definitionCN: 互相；反身是自向动作

entries.definition: another way to say unaided, as emphatic as by themselves
entries.definitionCN: 凭自己的另一说法，与 by themselves 同等强调

entries.definition: the stressing core inside every reflexive pronoun
entries.definitionCN: 每个反身代词里的强调核心

normalIntro.en: Real links: them plus selves, the mirror image, the emphatic second position, and by themselves.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：them 加 selves、镜像意象、表强调的第二位置、以及 by themselves。

normal.en: Themselves = them + selves: the group turned to face itself.
normal.cn: themselves = them + selves：群体转回身面对自己。

normal.en: They taught themselves: the teaching lands back on the teachers.
normal.cn: they taught themselves：教落回教者自身。

normal.en: The workers themselves painted it: emphasis, not mirror.
normal.cn: the workers themselves painted it：是强调，不是镜像。

normal.en: By themselves means no helping hand at all.
normal.cn: by themselves 意味着全无援手。

normal.en: Each other is a ball passed between two; themselves is a ball thrown straight up.
normal.cn: each other 是两人间传的球；themselves 是直直抛向自己头顶的球。

abstract.en: Reflexive grammar is the sentence looking into a mirror.
abstract.cn: 反身语法是句子照镜子。

abstract.en: Some actions only exist when they curve back home.
abstract.cn: 有些动作只有弯回自身才成立。

abstract.en: The hidden one borrows the plural mirror until a singular one is built.
abstract.cn: 被隐藏者在单数镜子造好前先借用复数镜。

examples.en: The students organised the festival themselves.
examples.cn: 学生们亲自动手组织了这次活动。

examples.en: They saw themselves in the old photographs.
examples.cn: 他们在老照片里看到了自己。

examples.en: Anyone scoring themselves should check the answer key twice.
examples.cn: 自行打分的人应把答案核对两遍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「载姆塞尔斯」——东西载在他们自己「塞」的「瓮」里，靠谁？靠自己 → themselves 他们自己

root: 古英语 self「自身」+ 诺斯与格 them + 复数 -s → 中古英语复合反身代词 → 现代英语 themselves；与 ourselves、yourselves 同法构成。

sensesIntro.en: Themselves mirrors the action back onto the group, adds emphasis in second position, and finally lends its plural shape to the single person of unknown gender.
sensesIntro.cn: themselves 把动作镜像回群体，在第二位置添加强调，最终把复数形态外借给性别未知的单数个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the group facing its own reflection in the mirror.
core.cn: 核心意象：群体在镜中面对自己的倒影。

branches.en: The action bends back to its doer.
branches.cn: 动作弯回它的发出者。

branches.en: The same word moved for pure weight.
branches.cn: 同一个词被挪位只为加重量。

branches.en: The plural mirror lent to one person.
branches.cn: 复数之镜外借给一个人。

branches.en: Mirror and emphasis are two positions of one shape.
branches.cn: 镜像与强调是同一形态的两个位置。

branches.en: Themself grows beside the borrowed plural.
branches.cn: themself 在借用的复数旁萌生。

intro.en: Themselves is itself a compound of them plus selves; the family repeats the same construction.
intro.cn: themselves 本身就是 them 加 selves 的复合；整个家族重复同一构造。

latinIntro.en: Themselves is Germanic; Latin reflexives are given only as contrast.
latinIntro.cn: themselves 属日耳曼语源；拉丁反身代词仅作对照。

items.example: Self came before selves.
I blamed myself.
We built the cabin ourselves.
Enjoy yourselves tonight.
The twins cycled home by themselves.
The leaves fell of themselves.

items.meaning: singular reflexive for one unknown person
items.meaningCN: 单数反身（用于未知个人）
items.example: Someone locked themself out.
items.exampleCN: 有人把自己锁在了门外。

items.example: Their better selves won the argument.
items.exampleCN: 他们善良的一面赢得了争论。

definition_zh: 然后；当时；那么；（紧接）于是；那时以来的
definition_en: at that time; next in order or consequence; or in that case, following from what has been said
core_image: 时间线上的下一格：上一个事件落定，指针才拨到它
scene: 烤箱计时器响了，她放下书起身。Beat the eggs, then fold in the flour gently.
sceneCN: 这里 then 是「然后」（第 1 个义项：紧接的下一时间）；句意：打散鸡蛋，然后轻轻拌入面粉。

collocations.zh: 不过话说回来；转念一想

derivatives.zh: 比（then 的孪生词，同出古英语一词后分化）
当场；立即（固定短语）
之后（同义时间副词，更书面）

senses.title: Next in time or order
senses.definition: at the next moment in a sequence of actions or events
senses.definitionCN: 在一系列动作或事件中的下一时刻
senses.example: Wash the rice, then soak it for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 淘米，然后浸泡一小时。
senses.why: The timeline has slots; then fills the one right after the last filled slot.
senses.whyCN: 时间线上有格子；then 填入紧随上一个已填格子的那一格。

senses.title: At a past or future time
senses.definition: at a particular time referred to in the past or future
senses.definitionCN: 在过去或未来所指的某个时间
senses.example: By then the sun had already set.
senses.exampleCN: 到那时太阳已经落山。
senses.why: Then can park at any single point on the line, not only the next one.
senses.whyCN: then 可以停在线上的任意一点，而不只是下一格。

senses.title: In that case; as a consequence
senses.definition: following logically from what has just been said, as in if you need help, then ask
senses.definitionCN: 从刚说的话逻辑地推出，如 if you need help, then ask
senses.example: If the last bus has gone, then we walk.
senses.exampleCN: 如果末班车已走，那我们就走路。
senses.why: The time pointer is bent into logic: when the condition is set, its result is the next slot.
senses.whyCN: 时间指针被弯成逻辑：条件一旦成立，结果便是下一格。

senses.title: Being so at the time mentioned
senses.definition: used before a title to mean holding it at that time, as in the then president
senses.definitionCN: 用于头衔前，表示当时任此职，如 the then president
senses.example: The then mayor opened the bridge in nineteen thirty.
senses.exampleCN: 时任市长于一九三零年为大桥剪彩。
senses.why: The adverb leans against a noun to date-stamp it.
senses.whyCN: 副词斜倚名词，为其盖上日期戳。

intro.en: Then is the older spelling of a word that split in two: the Old English adverb þanne meant both at that time and than. Modern English kept both senses but gave each a spelling.
intro.cn: then 是一个一分为二的词的旧拼写：古英语副词 þanne 既指「那时」也作「比」。现代英语保留两个义项，但各配一个拼写。

items.en: Þanne, also written þonne, meant at that time and served comparison alike.
items.cn: þanne（亦作 þonne）意为那时，同样充当比较词。

items.en: It descends from a Germanic demonstrative adverb related to that, a pointer aimed at time.
items.cn: 它源自日耳曼指示副词，与 that 相关，是瞄准时间的指针。

items.en: Middle English spelled it then, than, panne; time and comparison senses interchanged freely.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 then、than、panne；时间义与比较义自由互换。

items.en: The correlative use the earlier ... then the later prepared the logical sense.
items.cn: 「先……then 后……」的呼应用法为逻辑义作了铺垫。

items.en: By the seventeenth century then kept time and logic, while than was reserved for comparison.
items.cn: 至十七世纪，then 保留时间与逻辑义，than 专管比较。

note.en: The first group is the twin and its family; the second lines up the time words that share the timeline.
note.cn: 第一组是孪生词及其家族；第二组排列共享时间线的词。

entries.definition: the comparison twin; one word in Old English, two spellings now
entries.definitionCN: 比较孪生词；古英语原是一词，如今两副拼写

entries.definition: the object pronoun; one letter apart in writing
entries.definitionCN: 宾格代词；书写上只差一字母

entries.definition: the topic word; looks close, unrelated
entries.definitionCN: 主题词；形近而源异

entries.definition: later, without the tight next-slot feel of then
entries.definitionCN: 之后；没有 then 紧贴下一格之感

entries.definition: the other consequence word; so states the result, then delivers it
entries.definitionCN: 另一个表结果的词；so 宣布结果，then 交付结果

entries.definition: the next item in order, usually without a clock behind it
entries.definitionCN: 下一项；通常背后无钟表

normalIntro.en: Real links: the twin than, the Old English pointer, if-then logic, and the then president.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：孪生词 than、古英语指针、if-then 逻辑、以及 the then president。

normal.en: Then and than were one word until spelling split them.
normal.cn: then 与 than 本是一词，拼写才分了家。

normal.en: First the eggs, then the flour: slots on a timeline.
normal.cn: 先鸡蛋，后面粉：时间线上的格子。

normal.en: If A, then B: time logic made visible.
normal.cn: if A, then B：把时间逻辑显形。

normal.en: The then mayor: a date stamp pressed onto a title.
normal.cn: the then mayor：盖在头衔上的日期戳。

normal.en: Now and then: two ends of the same pointer.
normal.cn: now and then：同一指针的两端。

abstract.en: Sequencing is the first logic a child learns, and then is its grammar.
abstract.cn: 排序是儿童学到的第一种逻辑，then 是它的语法。

abstract.en: A consequence is just a future that a condition has already chosen.
abstract.cn: 结果不过是条件早已选定的未来。

abstract.en: One old pointer split into time, logic and comparison.
abstract.cn: 一根古老的指针分成了时间、逻辑与比较。

examples.en: She signed the form, then left without a word.
examples.cn: 她签了字，然后一言不发地离开。

examples.en: Back then, nobody owned more than one phone.
examples.cn: 那时候，没有人有超过一部手机。

examples.en: If the rain stops, then the match starts at three.
examples.cn: 如果雨停，比赛三点开始。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赞」——上一件事刚做完就「赞」到下一件，接得快 → then 然后

root: 古英语副词 þanne/þonne（那时；亦作比较词）→ 日耳曼指示副词 → 近代英语与 than 拼写分化，then 保留时间与逻辑义。

sensesIntro.en: Then starts as a pointer at the next moment, can rest at any single time, bends into logical consequence, and finally leans on titles as a date stamp.
sensesIntro.cn: then 起于指向下一刻的指针，可停驻任意时点，弯成逻辑推论，最终斜倚头衔作日期戳。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the clock hand clicking to the next notch.
core.cn: 核心意象：钟表指针咔哒一声拨到下一格。

branches.en: The next slot on the timeline.
branches.cn: 时间线上的下一格。

branches.en: Parked at any chosen moment.
branches.cn: 停驻于任一选定时刻。

branches.en: The pointer bent into if-then logic.
branches.cn: 被弯成 if-then 逻辑的指针。

branches.en: The pointer pressed flat onto a title.
branches.cn: 被压平贴上头衔的指针。

branches.en: Sequence and consequence share one clicking hand.
branches.cn: 排序与推论共用同一只咔哒之手。

intro.en: Then has no affixes; its family is the split twin than and the demonstrative ancestors.
intro.cn: then 没有词缀；其家族是孪生词 than 及指示词祖先。

latinIntro.en: Then is Germanic; the Latin time adverbs are given only as contrast.
latinIntro.cn: then 属日耳曼语源；拉丁时间副词仅作对照。

items.meaning: then; the single ancestor of then and than
items.meaningCN: then 与 than 的共同祖先
items.example: Þanne split into then and than.
items.exampleCN: þanne 分成了 then 与 than。

items.example: Taller than his brother.
He paid there and then.
We meet now and then.
She never wrote since then.
By then the shops had shut.
Maybe not, then again maybe yes.
Just then the phone rang.

definition_zh: 理论的；理论上的；假设的；以理论推理为依据的
definition_en: based on general principles and reasoning rather than on practice, observation or direct experiment
core_image: 黑板上推演到一半的公式，与现实车间里尚未造出的机器隔着一段距离
scene: 理论组把公式钉满白板，实验组在旁摇头。Theoretical physics often runs decades ahead of experiment.
sceneCN: 这里 theoretical 指「理论的」（第 1 个义项：依据原理与推理、而非实践与实验）；句意：理论物理学往往比实验领先数十年。图中可辨识物件：写满推演的黑板、尚未装配的仪器草图。

pos.zh: 理论的；理论上的；假设的（与 practical、experimental、applied 相对）

derivatives.zh: 理论；学说；原理
理论家；理论工作者
理论上；按理说
理论的（多见于 theoretic framework 等学术搭配）
建立理论；作理论推断
定理（与 theory 同出希腊 theōrēma「所观之物」）

senses.title: Based on Theory
senses.titleCN: 理论的：依据原理而非实践
senses.definition: based on ideas and general principles rather than on practice or experiment
senses.definitionCN: 依据观念与一般原理，而非实践或实验的
senses.example: Theoretical physics often runs decades ahead of experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 理论物理学往往比实验领先数十年。
senses.why: Greek theoria named looking and contemplating. The adjective marks knowledge reached by reasoning about principles, not by handling the thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 theoria 指观看与沉思。这个形容词标出的是通过对原理的推理而获得的知识，而不是亲手处理事物得来的知识。

senses.title: Hypothetical
senses.titleCN: 假设的：只为推理而设想
senses.definition: imagined or supposed for the purpose of reasoning, not actual
senses.definitionCN: 为推理而设想或假定，并非实际存在
senses.example: Let us take a theoretical case in which nobody pays tax.
senses.exampleCN: 让我们设想一个没人缴税的理论情形。
senses.why: A case built to test an argument is not observed anywhere. It exists only inside the reasoning, so the adjective shifts from 'about theory' to 'merely supposed'.
senses.whyCN: 为检验论证而构造的情形并不在任何地方被观察到，它只存在于推理之中；于是这个形容词从「关于理论的」滑向「仅仅假设的」。

senses.title: Predicted but Unseen
senses.titleCN: 理论预言的：尚未观测到
senses.definition: predicted by theory but not yet observed
senses.definitionCN: 由理论预言、但尚未被观测到的
senses.example: The theoretical particle would leave only a tiny trace in the detector.
senses.exampleCN: 这种理论粒子只会在探测器中留下极微小的痕迹。
senses.why: Theory can name something before any instrument sees it. The adjective marks that priority of reasoning over observation, which is common in particle physics.
senses.whyCN: 理论可以在任何仪器看见某物之前先给它命名；这个形容词标出的正是推理先于观测，这在粒子物理中很常见。

senses.title: Of the Theory Branch
senses.titleCN: 理论分支的：学科的理论侧
senses.definition: belonging to the branch of a subject that studies principles rather than applications
senses.definitionCN: 属于研究原理而非应用的那个学科分支
senses.example: She holds a chair in theoretical computer science.
senses.exampleCN: 她担任理论计算机科学方向的教授。
senses.why: Disciplines split into theory and application. The adjective labels the theory side, where the aim is to prove what is possible, not to ship a product.
senses.whyCN: 学科会分成理论与应用两侧；这个形容词标出理论一侧，其目标是证明什么在原理上可行，而不是交付产品。

senses.title: Idealized Model
senses.titleCN: 理想化模型的：删去复杂细节
senses.definition: belonging to an idealized model that leaves out complicating details
senses.definitionCN: 属于省略了复杂细节的理想化模型
senses.example: The theoretical model assumes a perfectly smooth sphere.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论模型假定球体完全光滑。
senses.why: A model is made by leaving things out. The word marks that the object is a construction, so its predictions hold only as far as the omissions are harmless.
senses.whyCN: 模型是靠删减造出来的；这个词标出该对象是一种构造物，因此其预测只在删减无碍的范围内成立。

senses.title: Possible in Principle
senses.titleCN: 原则上可能的：逻辑容许
senses.definition: possible according to reasoning, whether or not it can be done in practice
senses.definitionCN: 按推理是可能的，不论实践中能否做到
senses.example: A theoretical solution exists, but nobody can build it yet.
senses.exampleCN: 理论上存在解法，但暂时没人能把它造出来。
senses.why: If the reasoning permits something, it is theoretically possible. The barrier lies in materials or cost, not in logic, which is why the two words 'theoretical' and 'practical' so often face each other.
senses.whyCN: 如果推理容许某件事，它就是理论上可能的；障碍在材料或成本，而不在逻辑，所以 theoretical 与 practical 常常成对出现。

senses.title: Abstract, Not Applied
senses.titleCN: 抽象的：带不务实的意味
senses.definition: concerned with abstract reasoning, often with a hint of impracticality
senses.definitionCN: 关心抽象推理，常暗示不切实际
senses.example: His answer was theoretical and ignored the cost of the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 他的回答是理论性的，忽略了该计划的成本。
senses.why: When reasoning ignores real conditions, the same word turns mildly critical: correct in the abstract and useless in this room. The tone comes from context, not from the root.
senses.whyCN: 当推理无视现实条件，同一个词就带上轻微批评：抽象上正确，在这间屋子里却没用。这一语气来自语境，而非词根。

senses.title: Consistent within a Theory
senses.titleCN: 理论体系内的：内部自洽
senses.definition: consistent with the definitions and assumptions of a given theory
senses.definitionCN: 与某一理论的定义和假定保持一致
senses.example: The objection is theoretical: the two claims cannot both hold.
senses.exampleCN: 这一反对是理论层面的：两项主张不能同时成立。
senses.why: Inside a theory, statements must fit its own rules. A theoretical objection attacks that fit rather than the data, so it can be settled by argument alone.
senses.whyCN: 在一个理论内部，陈述必须符合它自己的规则；理论性反对攻击的正是这种吻合，而不是数据，因此仅凭论证就能解决。

intro.en: Theoretical descends from Greek theōria 'a looking, contemplation', through Latin theoreticus. The Greek noun is usually traced to theoros 'spectator', but the details of the earliest formation are debated.
intro.cn: theoretical 经拉丁 theoreticus 上溯希腊 theōria「观看、沉思」。这个希腊名词通常追溯到 theoros「观看者」，但最早构词细节仍有争议。

items.en: The noun thea is generally taken to mean 'a view, a sight', and horan means 'to see'. Together they are thought to give theoros, 'one who looks on', especially a spectator at a festival or an envoy consulting an oracle.
items.cn: 名词 thea 一般认为是「景象、观看」，horan 意为「看见」；两者合成 theoros，即「观看的人」，尤指节庆上的观众或去求神谕的使者。此说一般认为是，细节并不完全确定。

items.en: From theoros came the noun theōria, 'the act of looking on, contemplation, a spectacle'. Philosophy borrowed it for the mind's disinterested viewing of truth, away from action.
items.cn: 由 theoros 产生名词 theōria，意为「观看的行为、沉思、景象」。哲学借它指心灵不带功利地观看真理，与行动保持距离。

items.en: Latin took the adjective theorēticus from Greek theoretikos, 'of contemplation'. The Latin form kept the philosophical sense of knowledge pursued for understanding rather than for use.
items.cn: 拉丁语从希腊 theoretikos 借入形容词 theorēticus，意为「沉思的」。拉丁形式保留了哲学含义：为理解而非为实用而追求的知识。

items.en: English theoretical appears in the seventeenth century beside the older theoretic. The -al form became the everyday adjective, while theoretic survived mainly in fixed academic phrases. The first citation is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语 theoretical 于十七世纪出现，与更早的 theoretic 并存。-al 形式成为日常形容词，theoretic 主要残留在固定的学术搭配中。确切首见书证不确定。

items.en: The modern contrast between theoretical and practical is older than English: Greek already opposed theōria to praxis. The pair therefore marks a division of labour, not a judgement that one side is useless.
items.cn: 现代 theoretical 与 practical 的对立比英语更古老：希腊语已用 theōria 对 praxis。因此这一对词标出的是分工，而不是判定某一侧无用。

note.en: The first group traces one Greek family whose members are easily confused. The second holds near-synonyms that sit at different distances from reality.
note.cn: 第一组梳理同一个希腊词族中容易混淆的成员；第二组是距现实远近不同的近义词。

entries.definition: A body of principles that explains a field. It is the thing a theoretical argument is built inside, not the adjective describing the argument.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指解释某一领域的一套原理；理论论证是在它内部进行的，而它不是描述论证的形容词。

entries.definition: A person who builds or studies theory. It names the human agent, so it never replaces theoretical before a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指建构或研究理论的人；它命名的是人，因此不能替代名词前的 theoretical。

entries.definition: An older adjective of the same meaning, now mostly confined to phrases such as theoretic framework. It is not a different concept.
entries.definitionCN: 同义的较旧形容词形式，如今多限于 theoretic framework 一类搭配；它并非另一个概念。

entries.definition: Imagined as a premise. It stresses that the case is not real, while theoretical may still describe a well-founded body of reasoning.
entries.definitionCN: 作为前提被设想出来的；强调情形不真实，而 theoretical 仍可指有根据的推理体系。

entries.definition: Concerning concepts or mental categories. It says the work happens with ideas, not that it is unproven.
entries.definitionCN: 关于概念或心智范畴的；它说的是工作以观念为材料，并不表示未经证实。

entries.definition: General and detached from concrete cases. It can be neutral or critical, but it does not imply a formal theory.
entries.definitionCN: 一般性的、脱离具体个案的；可中性也可带批评，但不暗示存在形式化的理论。

entries.definition: Based on conjecture with little evidence. It is more negative than theoretical, which can be rigorous.
entries.definitionCN: 基于猜测而证据不足的；比 theoretical 更负面，因为 theoretical 可以是严谨的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: theoria 'a looking' + -al: knowledge from viewing principles with the mind.
normal.cn: theoria「观看」+ -al：用心灵观看原理而得到的知识。

normal.en: The family runs theory, theorist, theorize, theoretic, theoretical, theorem.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 theory、theorist、theorize、theoretic、theoretical、theorem。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the use: theoretical framework, theoretical physics, theoretical model, theoretical possibility.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：理论框架、理论物理学、理论模型、理论上的可能性。

normal.en: The opposite pair is theoretical and practical, or theoretical and experimental.
normal.cn: 对立搭配是 theoretical 与 practical，或 theoretical 与 experimental。

normal.en: theorem is a proved statement; theory is the whole system that contains it.
normal.cn: theorem 是被证明的命题；theory 是包含它的整个体系。

abstract.en: Picture a map drawn years before anyone walks the ground it describes.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，在任何人走过它所描述的地面之前许多年就已画好。

abstract.en: Picture a model ship in a bottle: exact in shape, unable to carry a single passenger.
abstract.cn: 想象瓶中船：形状精确，却载不了一位乘客。

abstract.en: Picture two people arguing about whether a door can open, without ever trying the handle.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人争论一扇门能不能开，却从不去拧门把手。

examples.en: The paper offers a theoretical explanation, but no experiment has tested it.
examples.cn: 这篇论文给出了一种理论解释，但尚无实验检验它。

examples.en: In theoretical terms the plan is sound; in practice it needs money nobody has.
examples.cn: 从理论上说这个计划是成立的；实践中它需要没人拿得出的资金。

examples.en: Students often find theoretical courses dry until they meet a real problem.
examples.cn: 学生常觉得理论课程枯燥，直到遇上一个真实问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: theory（理论）+ etical（形容词词尾）→ 属于理论的 → theoretical 理论的

root: 希腊 thea「景象」+ horan「看见」→ theoros「观看者」→ theōria「观看、沉思」→ 拉丁 theoreticus → 英语 theoretical。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with reasoning rather than practice and fan out: a hypothetical case, an unobserved prediction, a branch of a discipline, an idealized model, a logical possibility, an abstract answer and an internal objection.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「以推理而非实践为本」出发向外展开：假设情形、尚未观测的预言、学科分支、理想化模型、逻辑上的可能、抽象的回答与体系内部的反对。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a formula worked out on a board, separated from the machine it describes.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑板上推演出的公式，与它所描述的机器之间隔着距离。

branches.en: REASONING APART FROM PRACTICE: knowledge from principles, which can look either rigorous or useless depending on the room.
branches.cn: 与实践分离的推理：来自原理的知识，视场合可显得严谨，也可显得无用。

branches.en: THE SUPPOSED AND THE POSSIBLE: a case invented for argument and a solution the reasoning permits.
branches.cn: 假设与可能：为论证而虚构的情形，以及推理所容许的解法。

branches.en: THE UNSEEN: theory may name a particle before any detector records it.
branches.cn: 未见之物：理论可在任何探测器记录之前先为粒子命名。

branches.en: THE BRANCH: a discipline divides into a theory side and an application side.
branches.cn: 分支：一个学科分为理论侧与应用侧。

branches.en: CONSTRUCTION AND CONSISTENCY: a model built by omission must also stay coherent with its own assumptions.
branches.cn: 构造与自洽：靠省略建成的模型，还必须在自身假定内保持一致。

intro.en: Theoretical is a Greek noun of viewing turned into a Latin adjective and then an English one: root words for sight, a noun ending, and an adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: theoretical 是希腊语中表示「观看」的名词，先转为拉丁形容词，再进入英语：表示视觉的词根、名词词尾，以及形容词词尾 -al。

latinIntro.en: Greek theōria produced Latin theoreticus and English theory, theoretical, theorist, theorize and theorem. The same sight-root appears in theater, a place for viewing, though that word reached English by a different route.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 theōria 产生拉丁 theoreticus，以及英语 theory、theoretical、theorist、theorize、theorem。同一个「观看」词根也出现在 theater（观看的场所）中，但那个词走的是另一条路径。

items.example: The theoretical part of the course comes first.
items.exampleCN: 课程的理论部分排在前面。

items.meaning: an organized body of explanatory principles
items.meaningCN: 有组织的解释性原理体系
items.example: The theory predicts a slow rise in sea level.
items.exampleCN: 该理论预测海平面会缓慢上升。

items.meaning: one who builds or studies theory
items.example: The theorist never visited the site she wrote about.
items.exampleCN: 这位理论家从未到过她所写的那处遗址。

items.meaning: to form or reason with theories
items.example: They theorized about the cause for years.
items.exampleCN: 他们多年来就成因进行理论推测。

items.meaningCN: theory 的较旧形容词形式
items.example: Theoretic work preceded any measurement.
items.exampleCN: 理论研究先于任何测量。

items.structure: theōrēma (a thing viewed, a proposition) + English form
items.example: The theorem holds for every triangle.
items.exampleCN: 该定理对一切三角形都成立。

items.meaning: of the stage; exaggerated as if acted
items.meaningCN: 戏剧的；如表演般夸张的
items.example: His grief was real but theatrical.
items.exampleCN: 他的悲伤是真的，却很戏剧化。

items.example: Theoretically, the bridge can hold twice that load.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这座桥能承受两倍的荷载。

latinEntries.meaning: a spectacle; a proposition to be proved
latinEntries.meaningCN: 所见之物；待证明的命题

definition_zh: 理论；学说；原理；推测
definition_en: a systematic explanation of facts, a body of ideas about a subject, the principles behind a practice, or an unproven speculation
core_image: 一群人坐在看台上远远观看一场演出：先看见，再试图解释。
scene: 讲座散场，学生们还在争论黑板上的假说。In theory, the bridge should hold twice its own weight.
sceneCN: 这里 theory 是「理论上、按推算」（第 6 个义项：抽象推算而非实际）；句意：理论上，这座桥应能承受自身重量的两倍。场景要点：图纸上的受力箭头、计算器、尚未建成的桥。

derivatives.zh: 理论的；理论上的
理论家
建立理论；推测

senses.title: A systematic scientific explanation
senses.titleCN: 科学理论：能解释事实的体系
senses.definition: a well-tested and widely accepted explanation of natural phenomena, supported by evidence
senses.definitionCN: 经充分检验、被广泛接受且有证据支持的自然现象解释
senses.example: The theory of plate tectonics explains why continents move.
senses.exampleCN: 板块构造理论解释了大陆为何移动。
senses.why: Greek theōria was a viewing, a act of watching. A scientific theory begins with careful observation, then builds the explanation that the watching supports.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 theōria 是“观看、观察”。科学理论从仔细观看开始，再建立观看所支持的说明。

senses.title: A body of ideas or doctrine
senses.titleCN: 学说：一个学派的一整套看法
senses.definition: a organized set of ideas or beliefs about a subject, often associated with a school or thinker
senses.definitionCN: 关于某一主题的有组织的一套观念或信念，常与某个学派或思想家相关
senses.example: He studied Marx's theory of history for his dissertation.
senses.exampleCN: 他为博士论文研究了马克思的历史学说。
senses.why: A single observation grows into a connected body of claims. The word then names the whole doctrine, not one explanation of one fact.
senses.whyCN: 单次观察长成一套相互关联的主张。这个词于是指整套学说，而不是对单一事实的解释。

senses.title: The principles behind a practice
senses.titleCN: 原理：一门技艺背后的道理
senses.definition: the general principles or rules underlying a practical art or skill
senses.definitionCN: 某一实践技艺背后的一般原理或规则
senses.example: She studied the theory of music before touching the piano.
senses.exampleCN: 她在碰钢琴之前先学了乐理。
senses.why: Watching a practice from above yields its rules. Theory here is the map of a craft, separated from the hand that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 从高处观看一门实践，就得到它的规则。这里的 theory 是一门手艺的地图，与实际操作的双手分离。

senses.title: A hypothesis offered as explanation
senses.definition: a proposed explanation that has not yet been proven or fully tested
senses.definitionCN: 尚未被证实或充分检验的提议性解释
senses.example: His theory is that the ship sank in a sudden storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他的假设是那艘船在突发的风暴中沉没。
senses.why: The same explanatory frame can be built before the evidence arrives. Then it is a hypothesis, but English still calls it a theory.
senses.whyCN: 同样的解释框架可以在证据到来之前先搭起来。这时它是假设，但英语仍称之为 theory。

senses.title: A speculative opinion
senses.definition: an opinion or conjecture based on limited evidence, often in everyday talk
senses.definitionCN: 基于有限证据的看法或猜想，常用于日常谈话
senses.example: My theory is that the cat knocked the vase off the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 我的推测是猫把花瓶从架子上碰了下来。
senses.why: In ordinary speech, watching becomes guessing. The word loses its scientific weight and names any attempt to explain what happened.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，观看变成了猜测。这个词失去科学分量，可以指任何对事情经过的解释尝试。

senses.title: In theory: as reasoned, not as practised
senses.titleCN: 理论上：推算成立，现实未必
senses.definition: used in the phrase in theory to mean according to reasoning or principle, as opposed to actual practice
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in theory，表示按推理或原理应当如此，与实际做法相对
senses.example: In theory, the system can process a million requests a second.
senses.exampleCN: 理论上，这个系统每秒能处理一百万次请求。
senses.why: Theory is what the spectator sees from the stand; practice is what happens on the field. The phrase sets the two viewpoints against each other.
senses.whyCN: theory 是看台上观众看到的，practice 是球场上实际发生的。这个短语把两个视角摆在对立面。

senses.title: Book learning as opposed to practice
senses.titleCN: 理论课：书本上的那一半
senses.definition: the part of a subject taught as principles and books rather than as hands-on practice
senses.definitionCN: 以原理和书本而非动手实践来教授的那部分内容
senses.example: The course balances theory with six hours of lab work.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把理论课与六小时实验课相平衡。
senses.why: In training, the viewing half and the doing half are separated. Theory class is where you watch and read before you are allowed to act.
senses.whyCN: 在培训中，“观看”的一半和“动手”的一半被分开。理论课就是你被允许动手之前观看与阅读的地方。

senses.title: Idle or unrealistic speculation
senses.definition: speculation that is impractical or disconnected from reality, often used with a critical tone
senses.definitionCN: 不切实际或脱离现实的推测，常带批评语气
senses.example: That is pure theory; no one has tried it on a real farm.
senses.exampleCN: 那纯粹是纸上谈兵；没人在真实农场里试过。
senses.why: When the stand is too far from the field, watching never turns into doing. The word then carries the old complaint against pure contemplation.
senses.whyCN: 当看台离球场太远，观看就永远变不成行动。这个词于是带上了对纯粹空想的古老抱怨。

intro.en: Theory comes from Greek theōria 'a looking at, contemplation', built on thea 'a view' and the spectator word theōros. Latin and French carried it to English, where it shifted from watching to explaining.
intro.cn: theory 来自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与“观看者”theōros 构成。经拉丁语与法语进入英语，语义从“观看”转向“解释”。

items.en: Thea meant a view or a sight, the thing seen. It survives in English words such as theatre, where the view is what the audience comes for.
items.cn: thea 意为景象、所见之物。它保留在 theatre 等英语词中——观众来剧院，正是为了那个“景象”。

items.en: Theōros was a spectator, and also an envoy sent to consult an oracle or to watch a sacred festival. Watching was a public and often official act.
items.cn: theōros 是观看者，也是被派去求神谕或观看宗教节庆的使者。观看是一种公共的、常常带官方性质的行动。

items.en: Theōria meant a looking at, contemplation, and later a body of speculative knowledge. Philosophy used it for the highest kind of seeing.
items.cn: theōria 意为观看、沉思，后来指思辨性的知识体系。哲学用它表示最高层次的“看”。

items.en: Latin borrowed theoria mainly in learned and theological writing. The word stayed close to contemplation rather than to practical skill.
items.cn: 拉丁语主要在学术与神学写作中借用 theoria。这个词始终贴近“沉思”，而不是实用技能。

items.en: French théorie reached English in the 16c. with the sense of a scheme of ideas, especially in mathematics and philosophy.
items.cn: 法语 théorie 于 16 世纪进入英语，义为观念体系，尤用于数学与哲学。

items.en: The scientific revolution fixed the modern sense: a tested explanation of evidence. The everyday sense of a guess is older and never disappeared.
items.cn: 科学革命固定了现代义：对证据的受检验解释。日常“猜测”义更古老，并且从未消失。

note.en: The first group is theory's own family; the second ranks explanation words by how much evidence they claim.
note.cn: 第一组是 theory 自身的词族；第二组按“声称有多少证据”排列各种“解释”词。

entries.definition: concerned with ideas and principles rather than practice. It describes the mode, not the claim.
entries.definitionCN: 关乎观念与原理而非实践的。它描述方式，而不是主张。

entries.definition: a person who develops or studies theories.
entries.definitionCN: 建立或研究理论的人；理论家。

entries.definition: to form theories or speculate about something.
entries.definitionCN: 建立理论；对某事进行推测。

entries.definition: a statement proven from axioms, not a general explanation. It shares the Greek root but is a different kind of claim.
entries.definitionCN: 由公理证明的命题，不是一般性解释。它共享希腊词根，但主张的类型不同。

entries.definition: a proposed explanation to be tested. It is explicitly provisional, where theory may be either tested or loose.
entries.definitionCN: 有待检验的提议性解释。它明确是暂定的，而 theory 可能是已验证的，也可能松散。

entries.definition: a body of beliefs taught by a church, party, or school. It stresses authority rather than evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 教会、政党或学派所传授的信念体系。它强调权威，而非证据。

entries.definition: a basic rule or truth that explains how something works. It is usually narrower than a theory.
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物如何运作的基本规则或真理。它通常比 theory 窄。

entries.definition: guessing about something without firm evidence. It matches the everyday and critical senses of theory.
entries.definitionCN: 在没有确凿证据的情况下猜测。它对应 theory 的日常义与批评义。

entries.definition: an opinion formed from incomplete information. It is formal and openly admits the lack of proof.
entries.definitionCN: 根据不完整信息形成的看法。它较正式，并公开承认缺乏证据。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek thea 'view' and theōros 'spectator' give theōria 'a looking at'. Family words theory, theoretical, theorist, theorize, theorem.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成 theōria“观看”。词族为 theory、theoretical、theorist、theorize、theorem。

normal.en: The theatre and theory share thea: both are about a view.
normal.cn: theatre 与 theory 共享 thea：两者都与“看”有关。

normal.en: A theorist is a spectator who writes down what the game explains.
normal.cn: 理论家就是一位把比赛所说明的东西写下来的观众。

normal.en: In theory is the view from the stand; in practice is the play on the field.
normal.cn: in theory 是看台上的视角；in practice 是球场上的踢法。

normal.en: A theorem is proved; a theory is supported. Different strength of claim.
normal.cn: theorem 是被证明的；theory 是被支持的。主张的强度不同。

normal.en: My theory about the vase is just watching turned into guessing.
normal.cn: 我对花瓶事件的 theory，只是把“看见”变成了“猜测”。

abstract.en: Theory is the distance we put between seeing and acting, in order to see better.
abstract.cn: 理论，是我们在“看见”与“行动”之间拉开的距离，为了看得更清楚。

abstract.en: A theory that cannot be wrong is not a theory but a belief.
abstract.cn: 不可能出错的理论不是理论，而是信念。

abstract.en: Every practice is watched by some theory, even when the practitioner denies it.
abstract.cn: 每种实践都被某种理论注视着，即使实践者否认这一点。

examples.en: Darwin's theory took decades to be accepted by biologists.
examples.cn: 达尔文的理论花了几十年才被生物学家接受。

examples.en: The theory of harmony is easier to learn with a keyboard nearby.
examples.cn: 手边有键盘时，和声学理论更容易学。

examples.en: In theory the vaccine is free, but clinics still charge an admin fee.
examples.cn: 理论上疫苗是免费的，但诊所仍收取管理费。

dict_mnemonic.text: “思理论”——坐在看台上边看边思，慢慢就成了理论 → theory 理论、学说

root: 源自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成；核心是“先看，再解释”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of theory, all one act of watching: from the spectator's view grows a tested explanation, a doctrine, a set of principles, a guess, a classroom subject, or empty speculation.
sensesIntro.cn: theory 的八个义项都源自同一个“观看”动作：从观看者的视角生长出受检验的解释、学说、原理、猜测、课堂科目，或空洞的思辨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: spectators in a stand, watching a game and trying to explain it.
core.cn: 核心意象：看台上的观众，看着一场比赛并试图解释它。

branches.en: EXPLANATION: the same frame is a tested theory when the evidence is in, and a hypothesis when it is not.
branches.cn: 解释：同一框架在证据齐备时是受检验的理论，证据未到时是假设。

branches.en: DOCTRINE: a named school turns one explanation into a whole body of teaching.
branches.cn: 学说：一个有名字的学派把单一解释变成整套教导。

branches.en: PRINCIPLES: the rules behind a craft, whether written in a book or taught in a theory class.
branches.cn: 原理：一门技艺背后的规则，无论写在书里还是在理论课上讲授。

branches.en: SPECULATION: everyday guessing and idle theorizing are watching that never reaches the field.
branches.cn: 推测：日常猜测与空洞空论，都是从未落到球场上的观看。

branches.en: IN THEORY: the stand's viewpoint set explicitly against the field's practice.
branches.cn: 理论上：把看台的视角明确摆到球场的实践对面。

intro.en: Theory's family is built on the Greek root for viewing. English adds -etical, -ist, -ize, and -em, while theorem keeps a distinct mathematical path.
intro.cn: theory 的词族建立在希腊语“观看”词根上。英语加 -etical、-ist、-ize、-em；theorem 则走出一条不同的数学路径。

latinIntro.en: The Latin forms are theoria 'contemplation', theorema 'a thing looked at, a theorem', and the Late Latin adjective theoricus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式是 theoria“沉思”、theorema“被观看之物、定理”，以及晚期拉丁形容词 theoricus。

items.meaning: based on ideas and principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 基于观念与原理而非实践的（-etical 构成形容词）
items.example: The paper is purely theoretical and offers no data.
items.exampleCN: 这篇论文纯属理论，没有提供数据。

items.meaningCN: 理论上；按原理（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Theoretically, the reaction should finish in an hour.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这个反应应在一小时内完成。

items.meaning: a person who develops or studies theories
items.example: Literary theorists disagree about the author's intention.
items.exampleCN: 文学理论家对作者意图的看法不一。

items.meaningCN: 建立理论；推测（-ize 构成动词）
items.example: They theorized about the cause of the collapse.
items.exampleCN: 他们对坍塌的原因进行了理论推测。

items.meaningCN: 理论化；建立理论的过程（-ation 构成动作名词）
items.example: The book mixes fieldwork with heavy theorization.
items.exampleCN: 这本书把田野调查与大量理论化混在一起。

items.meaningCN: 由公理证明的命题；定理
items.example: The theorem holds for every prime greater than two.
items.exampleCN: 该定理对每个大于二的素数都成立。

items.meaning: according to principle, not necessarily in fact
items.meaningCN: 理论上；按理说（未必符合事实）
items.example: In theory, the two systems can run together.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这两个系统可以同时运行。

items.meaning: the explanation of species change by natural selection
items.meaningCN: 进化论；以自然选择解释物种变化的理论
items.example: The theory of evolution rests on fossil and genetic evidence.
items.exampleCN: 进化论建立在化石与遗传学证据之上。

items.meaning: a lesson teaching principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 理论课；讲授原理而非实践的课程
items.example: Theory class meets on Monday; the lab is on Wednesday.
items.exampleCN: 理论课在周一，实验课在周三。

items.meaning: an explanation that claims a secret plot by powerful groups
items.meaningCN: 阴谋论；声称有权势集团秘密策划的解释
items.example: The rumour grew into a full conspiracy theory.
items.exampleCN: 这个传言发展成了完整的阴谋论。

latinEntries.meaning: a thing looked at, a proposition, a theorem

latinEntries.structure: Late Latin adjective from Greek theōrikos

definition_zh: 治疗；疗法；心理治疗
definition_en: the treatment of a physical or mental condition, especially without surgery or drugs
core_image: 每周同一时间推开的那扇门：把伤处摊开在有光照的地方
scene: 她在楼下列了整整一周的康复课表。The knee healed faster after two months of therapy.
sceneCN: 这里 therapy 是「治疗；康复治疗」（第 1 个义项：对身体的非药物系统治疗）；句意：经过两个月的治疗，膝盖好得更快了。

derivatives.zh: 治疗师；治疗专家（therapy 加表人后缀 -ist 构成）
治疗的；有疗效的（同根形容词，经拉丁语进入英语）
有疗效地；治疗上（therapeutic 加副词后缀）
心理治疗（psycho- 加 therapy 复合）

senses.title: Treatment for a physical condition
senses.definition: a planned programme of treatment for an illness or injury, especially without surgery
senses.definitionCN: 针对疾病或损伤的系统性治疗方案，尤指非手术者
senses.example: The doctor recommended a course of therapy for the shoulder.
senses.exampleCN: 医生建议为肩膀做一个疗程的治疗。
senses.why: Care arranged as a programme: the wound is met on schedule, again and again.
senses.whyCN: 被安排成方案的治疗：伤口按计划被一次次照看。

senses.title: Treatment of the mind
senses.definition: treatment intended to relieve mental or emotional problems, usually through talking
senses.definitionCN: 以谈话等方式缓解心理或情绪问题的治疗
senses.example: She started therapy after the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 事故之后她开始接受心理治疗。
senses.why: Talking becomes the medicine; the door opens weekly to the same room.
senses.whyCN: 谈话成为药；每周推开同一扇门。

senses.title: Anything that comforts or restores
senses.definition: an activity that makes a person feel better, used figuratively
senses.definitionCN: 使人好受些的活动，比喻用法
senses.example: Shopping, he says, is his weekend therapy.
senses.exampleCN: 他说购物是他周末的疗愈。
senses.why: The medical sense relaxes into daily comfort: anything that soothes is called therapy.
senses.whyCN: 医疗义松弛为日常抚慰：凡能安抚的都被称为 therapy。

intro.en: Therapy comes from Greek therapeia, attendance or treatment, from therapeuein, to serve or care for. The healer began as a servant who kept attending.
intro.cn: therapy 出自希腊语 therapeia「侍奉、照护」，词根 therapeuein 意为服侍、照料。治疗者最初是一位持续照料的服务者。

items.en: Therapeuein meant to serve, to be an attendant; care preceded cure.
items.cn: therapeuein 意为服侍、照料；先有照护，后有治愈。

items.en: Therapeia named the whole attendance: the food, the baths, the watchful nights, not only the drug.
items.cn: therapeia 指整套照护：饮食、沐浴、彻夜看护，而不仅是药物。

items.en: Latin borrowed therapeutice in medical writing, keeping the Greek sense of systematic cure.
items.cn: 拉丁语在医学写作中借入 therapeutice，保留希腊语系统治疗之义。

items.en: English took therapeutic in late Middle English, while therapy itself stayed rare.
items.cn: 英语在晚期中古英语借入 therapeutic，therapy 本身仍罕用。

items.en: The nineteenth and twentieth centuries multiplied the therapies and made therapy the everyday word, mental treatment included.
items.cn: 十九二十世纪各种疗法激增，therapy 成为日常词，并纳入心理治疗。

note.en: The first group follows the caring root into its family; the second separates therapy from the wider cure words.
note.cn: 第一组沿「照护」词根走进词族；第二组把 therapy 与更宽泛的治愈类词分开。

entries.definition: the person who gives therapy; the -ist names the doer
entries.definitionCN: 治疗师；-ist 给行为者命名

entries.definition: having healing power; the older adjective of the family
entries.definitionCN: 有疗效的；词族中更年长的形容词

entries.definition: the playhouse; the seeing root of Greek, not the caring root
entries.definitionCN: 剧场；出自希腊「观看」词根而非「照护」词根

entries.definition: the general word for medical care; therapy names one planned method
entries.definitionCN: 医疗的总称；therapy 特指成套方案

entries.definition: the end result of healing; therapy is the road, cure the destination
entries.definitionCN: 治愈；therapy 是路，cure 是终点

entries.definition: the longer programme of restoring ability; often built from therapies
entries.definitionCN: 康复计划；常由多种 therapy 组成

normalIntro.en: Real links: the Greek serving root, the therapist with -ist, the therapeutic adjective, and shopping as weekend therapy.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：希腊「服侍」词根、带 -ist 的 therapist、形容词 therapeutic、以及被称作周末疗愈的购物。

normal.en: Therapy begins as attendance: showing up, again and again.
normal.cn: therapy 始于照护：一次又一次到场。

normal.en: The therapist is the -ist of therapy: the one who serves the cure.
normal.cn: therapist 是 therapy 的 -ist：执行治愈的服侍者。

normal.en: Therapeutic and therapy share one Greek caring root.
normal.cn: therapeutic 与 therapy 共享希腊「照料」词根。

normal.en: A course of therapy is care arranged on a calendar.
normal.cn: a course of therapy 是被排上日历的照护。

normal.en: Weekend therapy: comfort borrowed the medical name.
normal.cn: weekend therapy：日常慰藉借走了医疗之名。

abstract.en: Healing is mostly attendance before it is medicine.
abstract.cn: 治愈在成为医药之前，大多是照护。

abstract.en: Talking can be dosed like a drug, weekly and on time.
abstract.cn: 谈话可以像药一样按周按时服用。

abstract.en: Every therapy is a scheduled return to the wound.
abstract.cn: 每种疗法都是对伤口的一次定时回访。

examples.en: Six weeks of therapy restored full movement to her wrist.
examples.cn: 六周的治疗让她手腕恢复了全部活动能力。

examples.en: His therapist suggested keeping a daily journal.
examples.cn: 他的治疗师建议他每天记日记。

examples.en: Gardening became her quiet therapy after retirement.
examples.cn: 退休后园艺成了她安静的疗愈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑟拉皮」——病痛「瑟瑟发抖」，被「拉」出去做「皮」肤按摩，就是治疗 → therapy 治疗

root: 希腊语 therapeuein「服侍、照料」→ therapeia「照护、治疗」→ 拉丁语 therapeutice → 英语 therapeutic 早入，therapy 后起；同根词 therapist。

sensesIntro.en: From Greek attendance, therapy becomes the planned treatment of the body, then of the mind, then any comfort called healing in daily speech.
sensesIntro.cn: 从希腊的照护出发，therapy 成为人体的成套治疗、心理治疗，再到日常语言里一切被称为疗愈的安慰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scheduled return to the wound, care repeated until it closes.
core.cn: 核心意象：对伤口的定时回访，照护重复直至愈合。

branches.en: Care arranged as a programme for the body.
branches.cn: 为身体安排成方案的治疗。

branches.en: Talking becomes the scheduled medicine.
branches.cn: 谈话成为按时服用的药。

branches.en: Any comfort borrows the healing name.
branches.cn: 任何安慰都可借用治愈之名。

branches.en: Body and mind share the same scheduled attendance.
branches.cn: 身体与心理共享同一套定时照护。

branches.en: The metaphor relaxes the medical sense.
branches.cn: 比喻让医疗义松弛下来。

intro.en: Therapy builds with the agent suffix -ist, the adjective therapeutic, and compounds with psycho-, physio-, chemo- and radio-.
intro.cn: therapy 用表人后缀 -ist、形容词 therapeutic 构词，并与 psycho-、physio-、chemo-、radio- 复合。

latinIntro.en: Greek therapeia reached English through Latin medical vocabulary; the serving root also gave therapeutae, the attendants in ancient temples.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 therapeia 经拉丁医学词汇进入英语；服侍词根还给出 therapeutae「古神庙中的侍者」。

items.example: The therapist works three evenings a week.
items.exampleCN: 治疗师每周工作三个晚上。

items.example: The hot spring has therapeutic value.

items.meaning: treatment of the mind by talk
items.example: Psychotherapy takes months, not days.
items.exampleCN: 心理治疗以月计而非以日计。

items.example: Physiotherapy loosened the stiff knee.
items.exampleCN: 理疗松开了僵硬的膝盖。

items.example: Chemotherapy weakened but saved him.
items.exampleCN: 化疗削弱了他的体力，却救了他。

items.example: Radiotherapy lasted six weeks.
Occupational therapy taught him to write again.
items.exampleCN: 作业疗法让他重新学会写字。

items.example: The garden works therapeutically on patients.
